title: Usage Abnormality Explorer — prototype notes
content:
Overview:
This doc captures a lightweight prototype and interaction notes for a Usage Abnormality Explorer (UAE) inside Console. The goal: give SREs, platform eng, and product owners an action-first surface for investigating sudden token/embedding spikes, quota overruns, and frequent rate-limit hits across credentials and routes.

Primary goals:
- Rapidly surface anomalies (token spikes, bursty QPS, unusual route patterns) and rank likely causes.
- Provide one-click triage: timeline -> suspect credentials/routes -> recent deploys / rollout changes -> cost impact estimate.
- Let operators simulate mitigation actions (throttle, route fallback, temp block) and preview downstream billing/SLO impact.

Who uses this and when:
- SRE on-call: during pager incidents to reduce blast radius and find root cause.
- Platform/infra: to validate autoscaling and quota policies after rollouts.
- CS/Success: to explain unexpected bills to customers and recommend fixes.

High-level surface (wireframe panels):
- A: Overview timeline (top): 1-minute resolution; stacked series for tokens, requests, rate-limit rejects, latencies. Color-coded by severity. Zoom into any window.
- B: Heatmap grid (left): credentials x routes; cells show delta% vs baseline and small sparkline. Click a cell to focus.
- C: Culprit scorer (right): automatic candidate list with score = combination of recent delta, historical volatility, and recent deploys. Each candidate shows: credential id, top 3 routes, likely cause tags (misconfigured client, bursty job, bot), suggested actions.
- D: Action playground (bottom): operator can apply simulated mitigations and immediately see estimated token reduction, estimated savings, and projected SLO risk. Includes pre-built templates (temporary throttle 50% for credential X, route-level fallback to smaller model).
- E: Trace links and recent deploys (modal): for any candidate, surface recent commits/rollouts (from CI), recent config changes (rate-limit policy updates), and correlated alerts (pagerduty / error budgets).

Key interactions / microflows:
- From alerts: clicking an alert opens UAE focused on the alert window, pre-filters by credential(s) hitting limits.
- Exploratory drilldown: timeline -> select window -> heatmap updates to window baseline; click highest-delta cell -> Culprit scorer populates.
- Quick pivot: credential -> show top downstream routes, top clients (IP/app id), and top prompt templates (if available) to identify job vs interactive traffic.
- Simulation: toggling a mitigation instantly recalculates expected token throughput (based on recent traffic patterns + smoothing), cost delta (using pricing table), and estimated percent change to latency/SLO.

Filtering, baselines, and detection algorithms notes:
- Baseline is rolling 7d median for same hour-of-day; anomalies are flagged if > 3x IQR or > 50% week-over-week delta. Options to switch to 1d or 30d baseline.
- Filters: time window, credential, route, region, model variant, request-type (chat/generate/embedding).
- Detection hints: label anomalies based on shape (sustained plateau vs sharp spike vs periodic bursts). Use different remediation suggestions per shape.

Suggested UI copy snippets:
- "Potential cause: scheduled job spike (detected pattern: daily 10m bursts)"
- "Simulate: apply 60% throttle to credential X — estimated token use drops by 42% over 30m"
- "Investigate: show recent rollouts affecting model v2.1"

Backlog & grooming items (rough priorities):
- P0: Backend endpoint that returns heatmap aggregates per credential+route with 1m resolution (JIRA-5123).
- P0: Culprit scorer microservice (simple rules now; ML tier later).
- P1: Simulation engine that applies filter and a set of mitigation templates to historical windows and returns projected metrics.
- P1: Alert linking from PagerDuty -> UAE deep link.
- P2: UI: timeline + heatmap MVP (static cells, click to open list).
- P2: Expose prompt-template grouping heuristics for chat/generate routes.
- P3: Add model-variant cost estimator and quantization-aware suggestions.

Acceptance criteria (MVP):
- UAE shows timeline + clickable heatmap for a chosen 60m window and returns top-10 credential/route pairs by delta within 3s.
- Culprit scorer returns ranked list with explanation strings for each candidate.
- Simulation playground returns token and cost delta estimates for at least 3 mitigation templates within 5s.
- Deep link from alerts opens filtered UAE view.

Metrics to track (post-launch):
- Mean time to mitigation (MTTM) when using UAE vs historical baseline.
- Fraction of incidents where UAE simulation was used to pick mitigation.
- False-positive rate of culprit scorer (ops feedback).
- Reduction in billing surprises for accounts that used a recommended mitigation.

Edge cases and privacy/security notes:
- Ensure customer PII is not surfaced inside prompt-template snippets; only show hashed fingerprint with sample tokens redacted.
- Role-based access: only SREs and account admins can simulate actions that would create policy changes. Simulation results are safe, but apply button requires elevated permissions.

Open questions / design unknowns:
- How much compute to spend for real-time simulation vs approximate estimator? (tradeoff speed vs accuracy)
- Should anomaly labels propagate to long-term Quality/Optimize evaluations?
- How to handle multi-credential correlated incidents (same client keys rotated across services)?

Next steps / immediate experiments:
- Build heatmap aggregate endpoint (infra experiment): sample 10 high-volume customers and run nightly to see signal quality. (Owner: Marco)
- Quick prototype: simple front-end with static JSON sample for 3 incident scenarios; usability walkthrough with ops team next sprint. (Owner: Aisha)
- Add a tiny simulation piece server-side that replays last 30m at 1m resolution and estimates token delta under a throttle multiplier. If results useful, iterate to probabilistic estimator. (Owner: Samir)

Appendix: example filter queries (for devs)
- Top credential spikes: "group_by=credential&metric=token_delta&window=60m&baseline=7d"
- Route-centric: "group_by=route&credential=acct-123&metric=err_rate,rl_rejects&window=30m"
- Simulate throttle: "replay_window=2025-02-09T13:00Z/2025-02-09T13:30Z&mitigation=throttle&throttle_percent=60&target=credential:acct-123"

Notes to self (loose ideas):
- Consider adding a "replay-as-user" view that shows sample request patterns but with all user content scrubbed. Useful for CS demos.
- Prioritize explainability for culprit scorer — ops must be able to see *why* an item got a high score.
- Keep simulation templates small and opinionated (we don't want a general policy editor in the MVP).

Status: draft — ready for a short design review and infra feasibility check.
